provenance: Corpus-wide citation-graph counts computed 2026-08-13 from the same Hudson Corpus snapshot as most-cited-cases.json (same 475,375 opinion-to-opinion edges across 76,725 Iowa appellate decisions). Read by data brief 001. Refresh together with most-cited-cases.json; the page asserts the two as-of dates and edge totals agree.

definitions.never_cited: decisions with no citing Iowa appellate opinion in the graph
definitions.at_least_100: decisions cited by at least 100 distinct opinions (likewise 500, 1000)
definitions.fifty_corpus_share: the fifty as a percentage of all decisions (50 / decisions * 100)
definitions.fifty_one_in: one citation in every N goes to one of the fifty (edges / edges into the fifty, rounded)
definitions.varnum_cites: citing opinions for Varnum v. Brien, 763 N.W.2d 862 (Iowa 2009), canonical node only
